title: Club Chair / Coordinator
summary: Holds overall responsibility for the club's organization, direction, and day-to-day coordination. Acts as the central point of contact and chairs Committee meetings.
duties: Coordinates the Committee and chairs regular meetings
Sets and communicates the club calendar in coordination with other roles
Ensures the club's rules and protocol are followed and kept up to date
Represents the club in external matters (venues, leagues, other clubs)
Mediates disputes and escalates disciplinary matters to the Committee when needed

title: Vice-Chair / Deputy Coordinator
summary: Supports the Chair and steps in when the Chair is unavailable. Often takes on a specific focus area agreed with the Committee.
duties: Deputizes for the Chair at meetings and events when required
Supports coordination of a specific area (e.g., membership, competitions)
Helps onboard new Committee members and new club members

title: Head Coach / Trainer
summary: Responsible for the sporting and technical development of the club. Owns training content and has final say on team selection alongside the captain.
duties: Plans and runs training sessions
Designs drills and monitors individual and team development
Gives feedback to members on performance and progress
Leads team selection decisions together with the captain
Sets standards for conduct and effort during training and matches

title: Team Captain
summary: The on-field leader and link between members and the Committee. Represents the playing group's voice in club decisions.
duties: Leads the team during matches and events
Co-decides team selection with the Coach
Maintains discipline, morale, and team spirit
Raises player concerns or feedback with the Committee

title: Treasurer
summary: Manages all club finances and ensures transparency in how funds are collected and spent.
duties: Collects membership fees and dues on schedule
Records all income and expenses
Approves routine, low-value expenses within agreed limits
Shares regular financial updates with members
Flags any budget concerns to the Committee

title: Secretary
summary: Keeps the club's administrative records and communications organized.
duties: Takes and distributes minutes from Committee and member meetings
Maintains the membership list and contact details
Keeps the club protocol and any policy documents up to date
Handles official correspondence (venues, leagues, insurers)

title: Equipment & Logistics Manager
summary: Ensures the club has what it needs, where it needs it, when it needs it.
duties: Manages kit, equipment, and supplies
Ensures equipment is available and in good condition for training/matches
Coordinates venue or field bookings
Organizes transport or logistics for away matches/events where needed

title: Communications & Events Manager
summary: Owns the club's public presence and internal communication and helps organize social/community events.
duties: Manages social media and group chat announcements
Shares results, highlights, and updates with members
Supports recruitment of new members
Organizes team activities and community events alongside the Committee
